entries.reason: Nox scans the pinned Node builder base and reports its bundled OpenSSL 3.5.9, but cannot establish symbol reachability. This is a build-only stage; the Node runtime is not copied into Ghostline. Tracked in issue #43. Remove when an official supported Node image includes OpenSSL 3.5.10 or later.
